title: Return the smallest and largest as a tuple
prompt: Write `minMax(values: number[]): [number, number]`. Return `[smallest, largest]` from `values`. For an empty array, return `[0, 0]`. The return type must stay a two-number tuple, not `number[]`.
hints: Try `[4, 9, 6]`. What should each slot hold after every visit?
Start both slots from the first value, not from 0. Think about `[5, 8]`.
Return `[low, high]` and keep `[number, number]` as the return type.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Starts both slots at 0, so an all-positive array reports 0 as the smallest.
Returns `number[]`, so callers lose the fixed two slots.
